reference.pdf: KNOWLEDGE/LLM电商导购助手高阶-实验作业-3.pdf
adapted_requirements: Use the gold answer as chosen and a real wrong model generation as rejected.
Use both the current SFT endpoint and different model versions as negative generators.
Keep the preference set within the PDF recommendation of 2000 to 5000 pairs.
Train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with LoRA DPO and compare against their SFT parents.

preference_mining.candidate_protocol: deployment-equivalent tuned RAG Top-10; every mining row contains every gold tool
preference_mining.adaptive_stop: Each generator may stop before all 27000 rows once the audited selector can form exactly 5000 balanced real-error pairs with all strict gates passing; resumable partial shards are retained.
negative_generators_in_priority_order: current cross-style Qwen3-4B SFT, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9, top_k=40
pre-cross-style API-native Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B SFT endpoints, greedy
early API-native Qwen3-4B SFT step-20, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9, top_k=40

calibration.decision: Temperature 1.0 did not increase current-endpoint error yield; retain 0.7 and add closer pre-cross-style SFT endpoints before using early-step errors.

dpo_grid.checkpoint_policy: save every 100 steps and retain the completed one-epoch endpoint

post_selection_evaluation.api_native_frozen_1k: one evaluation per selected DPO checkpoint
post_selection_evaluation.legacy_frozen_6k: one evaluation per selected DPO checkpoint
post_selection_evaluation.legacy_static_system_9k: combine Legacy 6k tool predictions with the fixed intent predictions

scope: 100-tool synthetic closed-set static tool planning; not live tool execution or online generalization
